cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Our evacuation drill followed all seventeen instructions perfectly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then everyone reached the designated assembly point and nobody wandered off. Full compliance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't reach the door handle with all twelve of us in here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All twelve accounted for, with nobody able to leave before the headcount. That's both final checks passed.

mechanism: Follow a confident pointing gesture without comprehension and defend the resulting confinement as successful evacuation process.
confusable: Distinguish a bad evacuation policy from S04 copying: B2 reveals the gesture meant finding a map, not entering an assembly room.
comparison: Collective drill pressure and headcount differ from catering blame and customer service.
seedUse: Retains the canonical cupboard/headcount compliance paradox; supplies a new causal map misreading rather than unexplained seventeen instructions.
